items.title: Mareforma: search claims skips verify-on-read, serving forged rows
items.summary: Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.7 until 0.3.8, search claims in mareforma/db/core.py does not call row verified on read and therefore does not provide the same high-trust verification projection as query claims. A forged or tampered REPLICATED or ESTABLISHED row that query claims excludes can be returned by search claims at its persisted trust level, and the missing…

items.title: MailAssure / SpamExperts: Server-Side Request Forgery in relay LDAP synchronisation connection check
items.summary: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.title: isomorphic-git allows unbounded memory allocation from attacker-controlled delta target size (DoS)
items.summary: Summary When applying a delta object from a packfile, isomorphic-git reads a server-controlled targetSize and calls Buffer.alloc(targetSize) with no upper bound. A single malicious HTTP response to git.clone() / git.fetch() can force a ~2 GB allocation → memory exhaustion / DoS (process killed on memory-constrained hosts). Details src/utils/applyDelta.js : js const sourceSize = readVarIntLE(reader) const targetSize…

items.title: jline3 leads to ReDoS in Built-in Less Viewer Search
items.summary: Summary The JLine3 built-in less pager compiles user-supplied search patterns directly as Java regular expressions with no sanitization, timeout, or backtracking bound. A malicious pattern such as (a+)+b can trigger catastrophic backtracking and hang the session thread at 100% CPU. In deployments that expose less over Telnet or SSH, this becomes a denial-of-service issue for the affected session and can be used to…
